endpoints.name: Influencer Email Finder API
endpoints.description: Find the public business emails of a creator from an Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X or Facebook profile, each with the pages it was found on.
endpoints.price: 0.5 credits ($0.0025) per call + 7.5 credits ($0.0375) per result; maximum 8 credits ($0.04) per call

url.description: Public profile URL, such as https://www.instagram.com/<username> or https://www.tiktok.com/@<username>.

requestSchema.description: Provide one Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X or Facebook profile URL in url. The profile, its bio links and its linked websites are checked for public contact emails; the result is one row listing each email with the pages it was found on.

endpoints.name: Social Media Profile Finder API
endpoints.description: Find the accounts a creator runs on other networks from one profile URL, with a 0 to 1 confidence and the evidence behind each match.

url.description: Public profile URL, such as https://www.instagram.com/<username> or https://www.tiktok.com/@<username>.

requestSchema.description: Provide one Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X or Facebook profile URL in url. Each row is one account the same creator runs on another network, with a confidence score and the evidence that links it.

endpoints.name: Age and Gender Detection API
endpoints.description: Estimate a creator's age range and gender from the profile photo on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X or Threads, with a confidence score.

url.description: Public profile URL, such as https://www.instagram.com/<username> or https://www.tiktok.com/@<username>.

requestSchema.description: Provide one Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X or Threads profile URL in url. Age and gender are estimated from the face in the profile photo, which suits accounts run by a person.
